qa.answer: You can't use Option/Digimon card effects to gain memory, but you can still lose memory if a card effect specifies as such.

qa.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. What happens if an effect is activated that causes you to gain memory on activation and lose memory at end of turn? (i.e. [BT1-090 Gravity Crush], [BT1-021 MetalGreymon], [BT1-040 WereGarurumon], [BT1-058 Chirinmon], [BT1-075 Digitamamon], etc.)
qa.answer: You can't use Option/Digimon card effects to gain memory, but you can still lose memory if a card effect specifies as such. At the end of the turn, you’ll lose memory as specified by each effect.

qa.question: Can I choose to only trigger <Draw 2> or give one of my Digimon +2000 DP? Do I have to do both?
qa.answer: You have to both draw 2 cards and give a Digimon +2000 DP if possible.

qa.question: Can I choose to give one of my Digimon only +2000 DP or <Security Attack +1>? Do I have to do both?
qa.answer: You have to give the Digimon both +2000 DP and <Security Attack +1> if possible.

qa.question: My opponent has used an Option card or other effect to give one of their Digimon <Blocker>. Can I use this card's effect to delete that Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: Can I use this card's effect to give one of my originally unsuspended Digimon <Blocker>?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: What happens if I activate this card's effect against a Digimon with no digivolution cards?
qa.answer: Nothing happens, but the game still treats it as if you used the Option card.

qa.question: I use this card's effect when my opponent's Digimon has no digivolution cards. If that Digimon later gains digivolution cards, can it attack?
qa.answer: Yes, it can.

qa.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. I attack my opponent with a Digimon that has <Security Attack +1>, and flip over [BT1-101 Howling Crusher] from their security stack. If its [Security] effect results in the attacking Digimon having no digivolution cards, does the attack end immediately?
qa.answer: No. You've already declared the attack, so even if your attacking Digimon loses its digivolution card, [Hexeblaumon]'s effect doesn't end the attack midway.

qa.question: What happens when I use this card while I have 1 or fewer cards in my security stack?
qa.answer: Nothing happens, but the game still treats it as if you used the Option card.

qa.question: After activating this card's [Main] effect, do Digimon that later enter the battle area by being moved or played also gain this card's effect?
qa.answer: Yes, they do.

qa.question: What happens when this card is revealed upon a security check?
qa.answer: It's trashed.

qa.question: A Digimon gains this card's effect and attacks. At such times, can I activate the [When Attacking] effect gained from this card's effect after the attacking Digimon digivolves by another effect?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: I play this card, then play a Digimon. Does it receive this card's effect?
qa.answer: Yes, it does.

qa.question: I use 2 copies of this card. When I attack with a Digimon, can I activate its When Attacking effect twice in a single attack, giving an opponent's Digimon -4000 DP?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: What does "original DP" refer to?
qa.answer: The DP value printed on a card is its original DP. This card's effect temporarily allows you to treat the DP value printed on an opponent's Digimon as if it were 3000.

qa.question: I use this card's effect to change the original DP of an opponent's Digimon to 3000. I then use [ST3-11 Seraphimon]'s effect to give an opponent's Digimon -4000 DP. If the opponent's Digimon drops to 0 DP, is it deleted?
qa.answer: Yes, when a Digimon's DP becomes 0, it's deleted.

qa.question: This card's effect has set a Digimon's original DP to 3000. If [ST1-13 Shadow Wing] is used to give that Digimon +3000 DP, is its DP now 6000?
qa.answer: Yes, effects that increase or decrease DP work as normal, raising the Digimon's DP to 6000.

qa.question: If I use this card's effect on a Digimon that's already getting +1000 DP from an effect, does its DP become 3000?
qa.answer: No, its original DP becomes 3000. 3000 DP and 1000 DP (from the effect) add up to 4000 DP.

qa.question: I digivolve a Digimon while this card's effect is active. What happens to the Digimon's DP?
qa.answer: Even after digivolving, the Digimon's DP is treated as 3000 until the end of the turn.

qa.question: I have 1 card in my security stack. My opponent attacks me with a Digimon with <Security Attack +1>, and flips over this card during the security check. Its <Recovery +1 (Deck)> activates, adding a card to my empty security stack. Does my opponent continue the security check?
qa.answer: Yes, they continue by checking the card that was added to your security stack.

qa.question: While this Digimon is in my battle area, my opponent's Digimon checks my security stack and flips over [BT1-107 Holy Wave]. Its [Security] effect activates, adding a card to my security stack. I ended up with the same number of cards in my security stack, but does this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect still activate?
qa.answer: Yes, a card was removed from your security stack, so it activates.

qa.question: While this Tamer is in my battle area, my opponent's Digimon checks my security stack and flips over [BT1-107 Holy Wave]. Its [Security] effect activates, adding a card to my security stack. The number of cards in my security stack remained the same, but can I still suspend this card to gain 1 memory?
qa.answer: Yes, because a card was removed from your security stack.

qa.question: I have a level 6 Digimon with a digivolution cost of 3, and use this card's effect to reduce that cost by 4, to -1. Can I digivolve into that Digimon by gaining a memory?
qa.answer: No, digivolution costs can't be reduced to less than zero. You can digivolve the card for free, but you can't gain memory with effects that reduce digivolution costs.

qa.question: Does activating this card's effect also reduce the digivolution cost of cards in my breeding area?
qa.answer: No, it doesn't. Since the card doesn't specify breeding areas, the effect doesn't apply to Digimon there.

qa.question: After using this card, can I reduce the digivolution cost of my level 5 green Digimon digivolving to level 6 when an effect to digivolve one of my Digimon is activated?
qa.answer: Yes, you can.

qa.question: My opponent has this Digimon in play. During my turn, I use an Option card like [BT1-109 Smashed Potatoes] or [EX1-071 Win Rate: 60%!] which has an effect that activates “the next time one of your Digimon digivolves”. After that, all of my opponent’s Digimon become suspended. If I then digivolve one of my Digimon, are the effects from the Option cards I used earlier negated?
qa.answer: No. You already used the Option cards and activated their effects, so this card’s [Opponent’s Turn] effect can’t negate them.

qa.question: My opponent uses an Option card or other effect to give one of their Digimon <Blocker>. Can I use this card's security effect to suspend that Digimon?
qa.answer: No, if your opponent's Digimon has <Blocker>, it can't be suspended with this card's effect.

qa.question: Can I use this card's effect to suspend both 1 of my opponent's Digimon, and 2 of my opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less?
qa.answer: No. You can either suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon, regardless of DP, or 2 of your opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less. You can't mix and match.

qa.question: Can I use this card's effect to suspend 1 of my opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less, and no other Digimon?
qa.answer: Yes, this card's effect allows you to pick 1 Digimon and suspend it, regardless of DP.

qa.question: I've given one of my Digimon this card's effect. Can I unsuspend it over and over again every time I use it to delete an opponent's Digimon in battle?
qa.answer: Yes. The effect has no limit to the number of times it can be used. As long as you keep deleting your opponent's Digimon, you can keep using the effect to unsuspend this card.

qa.question: I've given one of my Digimon this card's effect. If it deletes an opponent's Security Digimon in battle, can I unsuspend it?
qa.answer: No, the effect doesn't activate in battles with Security Digimon.

qa.question: I've given one of my Digimon this card's effect. I attack with it, and my opponent blocks it. If my Digimon deletes the opponent's blocking Digimon and survives, can I unsuspend it?
qa.answer: Yes, if your Digimon deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives, you can unsuspend it, even if the opposing Digimon had <Blocker>.

qa.question: I've given one of my Digimon this card's effect. I attack an opponent's Digimon with it, and an effect causes one of my opponent's other Digimon to be deleted during the battle. Do I still get to unsuspend my attacking Digimon?
qa.answer: No. You can only unsuspend the Digimon with this effect if it deletes the Digimon it's currently attacking. Other Digimon don't count.

qa.question: I use [BT-112 Dimension Scissor], which allows 1 of my Digimon to unsuspend every time it deletes an opponent's Digimon. If I then use this card and attack an opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards, can I unsuspend my Digimon using Dimension Scissor's effect after deleting the opponent's Digimon using this card's effect?
qa.answer: No, Dimension Scissor requires the Digimon to attack and delete an opponent's Digimon and survive the battle. This card's effect deletes the opposing Digimon before the battle begins, so the effect doesn't apply.

qa.question: I use this card's effect on one of my opponent's Digimon, which they then digivolve. Can it now attack and block?
qa.answer: No, it can't.

qa.question: Does this card's security effect also prevent my opponent's suspended Tamers from unsuspending during their unsuspend phase?
qa.answer: No, this card's security effect only affects Digimon. Your opponent's Tamers unsuspend as normal.

qa.question: My opponent has [ST1-09 MetalGreymon], [BT1-021 MetalGreymon], and [BT1-114 MetalGreymon] in play in their battle area. I use this card's When Digivolving effect to choose [ST1-09 MetalGreymon]. Are all of my opponent's [MetalGreymon] cards deleted?
qa.answer: Yes. The card numbers may be different, but the names match. All of your opponent's [MetalGreymon] cards are deleted.

qa.question: Can this Digimon attack when I have less than 5 memory?
qa.answer: Yes, it can. Even if this Digimon's attack effect causes your memory to move to 1 or greater on your opponent's side, it doesn't become your opponent's turn until the end of the attack.

qa.question: Does this card's When Attacking effect activate when I have a Tamer that isn't blue in play?
qa.answer: Yes, it does. This card's When Attacking effect doesn't depend upon the color of your Tamers.

qa.question: I have 2 blue Tamers in play. During my turn, does this card's inherited effect grant +2000 DP?
qa.answer: No. No matter how many blue Tamers you have in play, the effect only grants +1000 DP.

comprehensive-0223.title: <Blocker>
comprehensive-0223.text:
16-5. <Blocker>
16-5-1. <Blocker> is a keyword effect that applies a rule that allows a Digimon with that effect to block. (For details, refer to 12 "Blocking")
16-5-2. <Blocker> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
16-5-3. Even if 1 Digimon has multiple instances of <Blocker>, the number of blocks that can be performed during the block timing is only 1.

comprehensive-0224.title: <Recovery>
comprehensive-0224.text:
16-6. <Recovery>
16-6-1. <Recovery> is a keyword effect where the specified number of cards from the specified area are placed face down on top of the security stack. This is shown on cards using text such as <Recovery +1>.
16-6-2. <Recovery> effects execute processing.

comprehensive-0225.title: <Piercing>
comprehensive-0225.text:
16-7. <Piercing>
16-7-1. <Piercing> is a keyword effect that reads "When this Digimon deletes your opponent's Digimon in battle while attacking, it checks security before the attack ends." (For details, refer to 13 "Security Checks")
16-7-2. <Piercing> is a trigger-type effect that triggers and activates when a Digimon with this effect battles an opponent's Digimon and the opponent's Digimon is deleted in battle. (For details, refer to 15-8-3 "Trigger- Type Effects")
16-7-3. The security check from using <Piercing> is mandatory.
16-7-4. <Piercing> is pending processing that is processed immediately before the transition to the end of attack timing. Therefore, it will trigger simultaneously with effects triggered by the battle, but it is processed before the end of the attack. (Example: If a Digimon with <Piercing> attacks and deletes a Digimon with an [On Deletion] effect in the battle, first the [On Deletion] effect is resolved, then <Piercing> is processed.)
16-7-5. Only 1 security check can be performed during a single attack, even if <Piercing> activates multiple times. However, if the number of cards that can be checked by the attacking Digimon is modified, that number of cards will be checked in a single security check.
16-7-6. If there are no Digimon to perform a security check at the point when <Piercing> is processed, a security check won't be possible.

comprehensive-0226.title: <Draw>
comprehensive-0226.text:
16-8. <Draw>
16-8-1. <Draw> is a keyword effect where a player draws the cards from their deck according to the number specified in the effect. This is shown on cards using text such as <Draw 1>.
16-8-2. <Draw> effects execute processing.
16-8-3. A draw from <Draw> is mandatory.

comprehensive-0227.title: <Jamming>
comprehensive-0227.text:
16-9. <Jamming>
16-9-1. <Jamming> is a keyword effect where a Digimon with this effect isn't deleted as a result of a battle with an opponent's Security Digimon.
16-9-2. <Jamming> is a persistent effect. (For details, refer to 15-8-2 "Persistent Effects")
